note: Rejudged independently against RFC 9234 Section 4.1: "An eBGP speaker MUST NOT advertise multiple versions of the BGP Role Capability." The single-polarity annotation remains supported by parseRoleContainer reading one scalar import role, extractRoleCapabilities emitting one declaration per selected peer, and GetCapabilitiesForSelectors selecting one injected capability per code across peer, address, group and global selectors. TestExtractRoleCapabilities_ParseBGPConfig requires exactly one capability and one selector for each configured role. dynamic-peer-gets-group-role-capability.ci compares the complete OPEN and all enclosing lengths with one 090101 TLV, so duplicate wire emission cannot pass as a substring match. Peer.pluginCapabilitySnapshot derives the encoded capabilities from that one selector snapshot, and buildOpenFromSnapshot packs them. The test inputs, tags and wire assertions are unchanged. This replaces the obsolete current-producer references in the prior note and makes no new runtime or discrimination claim.
